requirements.quote: At contract freeze, every frozen validate and repro command is probed in the **chosen placement** (resolve argv[0], `poetry`/`npx` binaries, `python -c "import pytest"` for `python -m pytest`, docker daemon for docker commands).
A miss either (a) installs it via a lane_tools recipe, or (b) re-places the lane **local** before plan starts.
It is never discovered at precheck.
Replaying this batch's issues #41009, #41093, #41096, #41095, #41077 and #40974 produces zero `env.tool_missing` / `env.repro_unrunnable` recoveries.
requirements.why: Needs a replay of AlterLab issues on the AlterLab repo (a third-party repo and its lane logs); this change ships the per-class tests (yaml recipe, repro_test probe, host-only rule) that cover each row.
requirements.bucket: owner:replay the six AlterLab issues on the AlterLab repo after release

requirements.quote: Contract validation rejects frozen validate commands that use host-only binaries (`legion-run`, `ssh <host>`, `/home/<user>/...`) or unbounded busy loops.
Replaying the #41095 plan fails at freeze with a contract rule, not at precheck.
A failing declared check stores its tail output in the result and the recovery comment (#41100 would name the failing lane check).

Host-overload: a lane whose declared checks would time out under current load waits in admission instead of building. Or: the timeout retry is deferred until load drops, and no `env.validate_timeout` recovery is started while `host_overloaded` is active.
Regression guard: lanes whose sandbox has every tool keep remote placement.
No change to builder resume counts for genuine conformance failures.
Metric: recovery share for an AlterLab batch of ≥30 issues stays under 5% of lanes (this batch: 11 of 39 issues, 28%).
requirements.why: Measured only over a real AlterLab batch of 30+ issues after release; no in-repo job computes it.
requirements.bucket: owner:measure recovery share on the next AlterLab batch of 30+ issues

deliverables.change: Add a `yaml` RECIPES entry (unversioned, apt python3-yaml; the binary `yq` is not provided) and map the binary names `yaml` to it via recipeFor/BINARY_RECIPES so hasRecipe('yaml') is true and installCommands('yaml') is non-empty. shellcheck exists already (line 19); vite and forgedock get no recipe: they are owned project deps (lean.mjs:2600), recorded as decisions K1/K2.

Add exported pure `hostOnlyProblems(contract)`: one problem string per validate or repro_test command (via contractCommands) that uses a host-only binary (`legion-run`, `ssh <host>`) or a `/home/<user>/` absolute path, or an unbounded busy loop (`while :`/`while true` with no sleep or timeout bound inside a CPU-stress wrapper, `yes > /dev/null`, `seq $(nproc)` loops). Each message names the id and how to fix the plan.

(a) Add hostOnlyProblems(contract) to the problem lists at the freeze-time correction (lean.mjs ~2520 `correctContract([...vc.problems, ...preflightProblems(missed), ...testRunnerProblems(...)])`) and its trigger condition, and to the first-plan validation, so a host-only or busy-loop validate is corrected once and then parks contract.invalid at freeze. (b) At the verify.precheck_block and no-new-commit needsHuman sites (~2783, ~2798) append `quietFailure(output)` (precheck.mjs:223, 40-line tail) of each failed check to the message and the T result so the recovery comment names the failing check. (c) Keep the remote probe (lean.mjs:2596-2625) covering the repro_test command and confirm R1 by test; no behaviour change unless the test shows a gap.

In the recovery path (~985-1010) when row.code is ENV_VALIDATE_TIMEOUT and `overload()?.overloaded`, do not launch the recovery lane: wait with `sleep(pollMs)` rechecking overload (bounded by a max wait so the batch cannot hang; one decided() row noting the deferral), then launch. A non-overloaded host and every other code are unchanged.
Document the host-only/busy-loop contract rule, the yaml recipe, the precheck tail and the overload deferral of env.validate_timeout recovery (#5749).
Add `#5749` tests: hasRecipe('yaml') true, installCommands('yaml') non-empty, vite/forgedock still have no recipe.

Add `#5749` tests for hostOnlyProblems: rejects the #41095 V2 `legion-run bash -lc '... while :; do :; done ...'`, `ssh host cmd`, `/home/u/x`; accepts `npx vitest run`, `python -m pytest tests/x.py`, `while read l; do ...; done < file`; also checks repro_test is covered by preflightProbes.

Add `#5749` tests: a remote lane whose planned validate is a legion-run busy loop is corrected then parks contract.invalid before the builder implements; a repro_test `python -m pytest` miss in the remote sandbox is detected at freeze and installs or re-places before the builder; precheck_block detail contains the failing check's output tail; a remote lane with every tool present keeps remote placement.

New `#5749` test file in the style of orchestrate-envhold.test.mjs: with overload() true an env.validate_timeout row starts no recovery lane until overload clears; with overload false the recovery starts immediately; a conformance.unimplemented row keeps its existing resume counts under overload.

preserve.what: Remote placement for a lane whose sandbox has every tool (lean.mjs:2596-2625 REMOTE probe path and toolplace.mjs:25 toolMisses/lackedTools unchanged in behaviour).
RECIPES existing entries and recipeFor/hasRecipe/installCommands/installLaneTools signatures and behaviour in bin/pool/lane-tools.mjs (#5650, #5652, #5764), incl. python3 alias mapping.

Builder resume counts and recovery attempt classes (recoveryClassOf, classUsed, maxFor) in bin/lean/orchestrate.mjs:985-1010 for every code other than env.validate_timeout, and the #5805 envHold behaviour tested in bin/lean/orchestrate-envhold.test.mjs.

Exported shapes of preflightProbes, preflightProblems, testRunnerProblems and contractCommands in bin/lean/preflight.mjs; ordinary validates (npx vitest, python -m pytest, poetry run pytest, bash scripts) stay valid.
Admission hold for non-remote placements under overload (orchestrate.mjs:735-743) and remote placements never held there.

regression.covers: orchestrate.mjs recovery path: resume counts, holds, cancel unchanged
toolplace/depcache/lane-tools neighbours: remote probe, nested deps, recipes

decisions.choice: No lane_tools recipe for `forgedock`: it stays an owned dep, not a recipe.
decisions.justification: lean.mjs:2600 `ownedDep = t === "forgedock" || remoteDeps.owner(t)`; #5727 merged (PR #5740) resolves the frozen checks.mjs path instead, so AC5's forgedock recipe is satisfied by that fix.

decisions.choice: No `vite` recipe: vite is a manifest dependency the lane prepares.
decisions.justification: preflight.mjs:388 manifestDepOwner and depcache.mjs:73-92 nestedJsLocks (#5683, #5423); #5747 closed already-fixed; a recipe would be skipped by notOwned at lean.mjs:2600-2601.

decisions.choice: Host-only/busy-loop check is a deterministic static rule in preflight.mjs, run in the existing freeze correction round, not a new agent.
decisions.justification: NORTHSTAR 'Where a fix belongs' layer 3 (script detects exactly); sits beside testRunnerProblems at preflight.mjs:145 and is consumed at lean.mjs:2520.

decisions.choice: Overload handling takes the issue's second option: defer the env.validate_timeout recovery launch while overload() is active, rather than admission-time prediction of check duration.
decisions.justification: orchestrate.mjs:735-743 already holds local admission by overload() snapshot; predicting a lane's check time is not deterministic, while the recovery launch site (orchestrate.mjs:985-1010) already has overload injected.

decisions.choice: The repro_test command is probed through the existing path: preflightProbes iterates contractCommands which already includes repro_test (preflight.mjs:107-111), so R1 needs a test, not new code, unless the test shows a docker-daemon gap.
